name: smwmusic-bonk-s-adventure-boss
title: Bonk's Adventure - Boss 1
description:
The regular boss theme from Bonk's Adventure a.k.a. B.C. Kid a.k.a. PC Genjin on the PC Engine (TurboGrafx-16), also reused in Bonk's Revenge. Some odd use of squares as quiet makeshift drums below the actual percussion, which was also in the source song.

Ported by ear by listening to each channel of the vgm.
